name: Net worth snapshot
audience: Individuals who want one page of assets and debts.
summary: List what you own and what you owe, then subtract.
description: Assets are split into cash you can reach and other assets. Liabilities are listed one by one. Net worth is assets minus liabilities. The workbook does not value a business or a property for you.
benefits: Separate cash from assets that would take time to sell
List each debt instead of one vague total
Update the snapshot without rebuilding the sheet
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
